title: Confidence Levels Vocabulary
description: Defines the standard and custom confidence levels available for assertions

ConfidenceLevelDefinition.description: Definition of a single confidence level

label.description: Human-readable label for the confidence level

description.description: Detailed description of the confidence level

gedcom.description: Corresponding GEDCOM QUAY value (0-3) for import/export mapping

rank.description: Numeric ordering used by glx diff to detect confidence upgrades vs downgrades. Higher values rank above lower. Standard levels supply ranks 0-3 (low=0, disputed=1, medium=2, high=3); archives extending the vocabulary with custom levels can supply a rank to participate in upgrade detection.
